instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. yarn test:app regressions (all passed before the run; the design requires single-page behaviour and existing snapshots to stay unchanged). (A) 57 existing tests in dragCreate, move, selection, multiPointCreate, contextmenu, regressionTests, history (packages/excalidraw/tests) and linearElementEditor (packages/element/tests) fail on snapshots: element `seed`/`versionNonce` values are shifted by one PRNG step, e.g. dragCreate rectangle: `- "seed": 1278240551, + "seed": 453191` and `- "versionNonce": 401146281, + "versionNonce": 1150084233` -> on a single default page something now consumes one extra randomInteger() (an extra newElementWith/mutateElement/bumpVersion or a re-created element) before or during element creation; and many `[end of test] number of renders` snapshots changed -> extra setState/re-renders on the single-page path (e.g. page/viewport sync in componentDidUpdate, updateScene or setActivePageId calls that set state when nothing changed). Make the page code a no-op on the single default page: no extra state updates, no extra element versions. (B) New tests in packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx fail: `AC-1: isolates elements and selection per active page: expected 1 to be 2` (line 42); `AC-2: keeps per-page viewport and clears selection on switch: expected +0 to be 100` (line 78, viewport not restored on switch back); `AC-3: renames, reorders and deletes pages: expected 'Page 2' to be 'SDK flow'` (line 102, renamePage has no effect); `AC-4: isolates undo history per page: expected [ 'rect2' ] to deeply equal []` (line 134); `AC-7: search switches to the page of the match: expected 'id36' to be 'page-1'` (line 243). Fix App's page methods (addPage, switchPage, renamePage, deletePage, per-page viewport and history scoping) so these pass.
